positions.title: Intern Software Development
positions.description:
Intern Software Development - ARM Real-Time Embedded Networking applications.

The project focused on layer two switches. I was part of a team which was handling firmware and SDK programming. My role was to support the team by enhancing and implementing new features. The following tasks were successfully completed during the tenure.
•	Firmware packaging script tool enhancement and testing (Python): Tool used for debugging purpose, it accepts filename and generate hexadecimal formatted file from a binary formatted file.
•	Enhance the firmware code by cleaning data section for restart functionality.
•	Implementation and testing of firmware memory type detection feature before the firmware flash process start.
•	Low level hook up function implementation for driver level I2C accessed memory and registers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Interfacing of peripherals with ASICs (Application Specific Integrated Circuits) of Layer-2 on core network routers CRS-1 & CRS-3 for CISCO systems. 
•	    Design, implementation and testing of new features for Physical Layer Interfacing Modules (PLIM) of CRS-1 & CRS-3. Triaging and fixing bugs in PLIM modules.
•	Handled customer issues on live traffic network during maintenance window.
•	Configured routers and traffic generators with scaled configuration for unit and integration system test.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, implementation and testing of various commercial and industrial embedded system projects. Interfacing different peripherals like EEPROM, LCD, RTC (Real Time Clock) etc. with microprocessors or microcontroller for various projects. 
•	Interfacing different kinds of modems and card readers like GSM, GPS modems and RFID. Successfully delivered service and support for customer issues.

projects.title: Multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe
projects.description:
Developed an algorithm for multiplayer tic-tac-toe game using socket programming and UDP protocol on Linux environment.
Multi-threaded client and server was used to support simultaneous games.

projects.title: Distributed DHCP Server
projects.description:
Project Goal:- 
        Design and Implement a distributed DHCP Server in a LAN Network.

Description:- 
        Implementation of distributed DHCP Servers in a LAN Network in which multiple network hosts can be automatically connected to the LAN network . The system ensures a centralized configuration with a distributed service, in which multiple DHCP servers present in the LAN take care of the clients configuration requirements independently. The system is centralized in the sense that the configuration detail, which includes parameters like IP addresses, lease configurations,default gateway etc., are fetched from a common configuration pool data base.On the request for a configuration detail,each of the servers would fetch  a unique  configuration detail from the pool and the choice of selection of the configuration detail is up to the client. Since the system is distributed, the service for the clients will not fail until anyone of the servers is functioning.

Achievements:-
        Implementation of the system provided  wide exposure to the DHCP protocol, Multi threading, Multi processing and Socket programming and the implementation of the same. 

Project gears:-
       Language:- C.
       OS:- Linux
       Compiler:- GCC.
       Debugger:- GDB.
       Network Environment:- VMWare virtual machines.
